muxt generate --use-receiver-type=T
muxt check

exec go test -count=1

-- template.gohtml --
{{- define "POST /users CreateUser(ctx, unmarshalJSON(body))" -}}<p>{{- .Result.Name -}}:{{- .Result.Age -}}</p>{{- end -}}
-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"context"
	"embed"
	"html/template"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templatesFS embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templatesFS, "*"))

type User struct {
	Name string `json:"name"`
	Age  int    `json:"age"`
}

type T struct{}

// createUserCalls lets the test prove the method is not invoked when the
// request body fails to decode.
var createUserCalls int

func (T) CreateUser(_ context.Context, u User) (User, error) {
	createUserCalls++
	return u, nil
}
-- template_test.go --
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func Test(t *testing.T) {
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	TemplateRoutes(mux, T{})

	post := func(t *testing.T, body string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		t.Helper()
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, "/users", strings.NewReader(body))
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		mux.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		return rec
	}

	t.Run("valid JSON decodes into the parameter", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := post(t, `{"name":"Ada","age":36}`)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if want := "<p>Ada:36</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
		if createUserCalls != 1 {
			t.Errorf("createUserCalls = %d, want 1", createUserCalls)
		}
	})

	t.Run("malformed JSON is 400 and the method is not invoked", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := createUserCalls
		rec := post(t, `{"name":`)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
		if createUserCalls != before {
			t.Errorf("createUserCalls = %d, want %d (method must not run)", createUserCalls, before)
		}
	})

	t.Run("empty body is malformed JSON", func(t *testing.T) {
		before := createUserCalls
		rec := post(t, ``)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusBadRequest {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusBadRequest)
		}
		if createUserCalls != before {
			t.Errorf("createUserCalls = %d, want %d (method must not run)", createUserCalls, before)
		}
	})

	t.Run("duplicate keys take the last value under encoding/json v1", func(t *testing.T) {
		rec := post(t, `{"name":"a","name":"b"}`)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Errorf("status = %d, want %d", rec.Code, http.StatusOK)
		}
		if want := "<p>b:0</p>"; rec.Body.String() != want {
			t.Errorf("body = %q, want %q", rec.Body.String(), want)
		}
	})
}
